## Summary
Root-cause the ~9% HTTP 500 rate on GET /slots and 527 HTTP 400s; correlate with concurrent giant prefills (parent: LP-0MTAQNB7J0094X71).

## Acceptance Criteria
- Classify 500s/400s by proximate cause (router-mode proxying, slot out-of-range during prefill, transient llama-server busy, restart races) with counts from the F1 corpus.
- Correlation of 500-storm windows with concurrent giant-prefill / high local_active_queries periods (F1 corpus + proxy.log).
- Fix options ranked by expected impact; flag which are already tracked elsewhere (LP-0MSVP7XJ6008QPKX, LP-0MSB0RV72001KNRV).
- Triage write-up (parent AC #3).

- **`/slots` 500 triage**: Root cause of the 500s (router-mode proxying, slot out-of-range during prefill, etc.) and fix options; correlation of 500s with concurrent giant prefills. (covers parent AC #3)

## Minimal Implementation
- Parse proxy.log /slots request failures with status codes and timestamps.
- Cluster failure windows; join with prefill activity and slot lifecycle events.
- Map each failure class to a root cause and candidate fix; dedupe against tracked items.

## Key Files
- /var/log/llama-proxy/proxy.log
- /var/log/llama-proxy/llama-server.log
- proxy/proxy/handlers.py (slots_stale handling)
- proxy/proxy/observability.py (_query_slots_detail)


## Dependencies
LP-0MTCMEJX2008W85X (F1 corpus).

## Deliverables
/slots triage section of evaluation report.
data.title: F3: /slots 500-storm triage

data.author: implement
data.comment: F3 implementation: triage script scripts/slots_500_triage.py + 8 tests (proxy/tests/test_slots_500_triage.py) + write-up docs/dev/slots-500-triage.md. Key findings (2026-08-26, llama-server.log-2026-08-27.gz): ALL GET /slots 500s (6,865) and 400s (527, exact match) are answered by the ROUTER (router-mode proxying); model instances answer only 200 (36,238). Proximate cause: router proxies /slots to a busy model instance mid-giant-prefill, the model cancels the proxied connection ('Connection handling canceled', 6,940 events ≈ 500 count 1:1), and the router returns 500. 53.3% of 500 windows contain concurrent prefill/checkpoint activity; 158 busy slabs. Fix options ranked: (1) query model instances directly / last-known-state fallback (dominant, zero GPU-wedge risk), (2) concurrency-aware timeout/backoff, (3) fix router cancel path, (4) dedupe slot-status aggregation. Flags LP-0MSVP7XJ6008QPKX, LP-0MSB0RV72001KNRV, LP-0MSHW2AXJ009DO3S as tracked elsewhere.
